title: Adic systems of finite modules over a complete discrete valuation ring
statement:
Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension].

1. Let $(M_n)_{n\geq1}$ be an inverse system in which $M_n$ is a finite $A_{E,n}$-module and the transition map $M_{n+1}\to M_n$ induces an isomorphism $M_{n+1}\otimes_{A_{E,n+1}}A_{E,n}=M_{n+1}/\varpi_E^nM_{n+1}\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n$. Then $M=\varprojlim_nM_n$ is a finitely generated $\mathcal O_E$-module, the projections induce isomorphisms $M/\varpi_E^nM\xrightarrow{\sim}M_n$, and the inverse-limit topology on $M$ (each $M_n$ discrete) is the $\mathfrak m_E$-adic topology.
2. Conversely every finitely generated $\mathcal O_E$-module $M$ is $\mathfrak m_E$-adically complete and separated, $M\to\varprojlim_nM/\varpi_E^nM$ is an isomorphism, and $(M/\varpi_E^nM)_n$ is a system as in (1). Every $\mathcal O_E$-linear map between finitely generated $\mathcal O_E$-modules is continuous for the $\mathfrak m_E$-adic topologies, and for finitely generated $M,N$ the reductions give a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_E}(M,N)\to\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Hom}_{A_{E,n}}(M/\varpi_E^nM,N/\varpi_E^nN)$.
3. For finitely generated $M,N$ and a finite extension $L/E$, $(M\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}N)/\varpi_E^n\cong M/\varpi_E^nM\otimes_{A_{E,n}}N/\varpi_E^nN$ and $(M\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L)/\varpi_E^n\cong M/\varpi_E^nM\otimes_{A_{E,n}}\mathcal O_L/\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_L$, compatibly with $n$.
